data.notice: Improvement Opportunities are deterministic rules over recorded figures. They are advisory and read-only: they describe what was recorded and where to look, they do not establish why it happened, and none of them is a reason to change verification, security review or a person's approval.

rules.condition: one station holds a large share of the total measured station visit time (volume-weighted: total, not mean)
rules.minimum: 20 measured visits over all stations, 2 stations measured, 5 measured visits at the station

rules.condition: a wait kind's 90th percentile of measured waits is long
a wait kind inside dispatch-to-merge (execution capacity, human approval, parked for a person) totals a large share of measured dispatch-to-merge time
rules.minimum: 5 measured waits of the kind and 5 measured C3

rules.condition: station visits in judging round 2 or later hold a large share of measured station time
rules.minimum: 20 measured visits with a recorded round, 5 of them in round 2 or later

rules.condition: first-pass rate is below the observe station's target
average judging rounds is above the observe station's target
escalation rate is above the observe station's target
review rejection rate is higher in the later of two consecutive equal windows
rules.minimum: a bounded window; 10 decided rounds and 90% coverage in each window; no suspect window

rules.condition: failed verification rate (refusals of the verify.verdict gate) is higher in the later of two consecutive equal windows
rules.minimum: a bounded window; 10 verdicts and 90% coverage in each window; no suspect window

rules.condition: failed verification checks of one kind recur across tickets (observe.py pattern rule)
rules.threshold: >= 2 tickets and >= 15% of tickets that visited verification

rules.condition: refusals of one gate recur across tickets (observe.py pattern rule)
rules.threshold: >= 2 tickets and >= 15% of tickets with a lifecycle log

rules.condition: review blockers citing one rule recur across tickets (observe.py pattern rule)
the scheduler recorded work held for a free place (its recorded max_parallel in use) on several days
rules.threshold: >= 3 day buckets with a recorded capacity wait beginning, >= 3 waits

rules.condition: recoveries, failed, interrupted or unknown-outcome executions above a share of executions (unknown outcome: attention)
the same execution measures are higher in the later of two consecutive equal windows
rules.minimum: a bounded window; 10 executions in each window

rules.condition: recorded cost is higher in the later window while integrated slices are not higher
rules.minimum: a bounded window; 10 executions with a recorded cost and 80% cost coverage in each window
rules.threshold: later cost >= 1.25 x earlier cost and T2 later <= T2 earlier
